verdict.rationale: Runway Dev's API paths are versioned under a `/v1/` prefix (e.g. `GET /v1/tasks/{id}`, `POST /v1/text_to_video`), and it publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, so a basic URL versioning scheme exists. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance. The 'versioned endpoints' wording refers to user-published Workflows, not the platform API's own versioning. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, sunset/notice timelines, version lifecycle and migration docs, explicit API versioning documentation beyond the /v1 path prefix, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: poll `GET /v1/tasks/{id}` until the task reaches `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED`
